decision_rationale: Ring 0–Ring 4 activation is accepted and No-Go is clean. The platform may support real EVE expert service cases as internal capture, transduction, traceability and control infrastructure, but only under consultant expert supervision and with a Consultant Expert Control Panel (or documented manual equivalent) before unrestricted real case operation.
conditions_for_full_real_operation: Consultant Expert Control Panel designed and implemented
Case scope, data boundary and client consent or service authorization documented per case
No-Go post-Ring 4 checklist clean at case start
Manual review, rollback/abort and audit trail operational
